name: laymbda
description: Serverless Laya inference on AWS Lambda.

scripts.benchmark: cd benchmark && uv run --locked locust -f locustfile.py
scripts.benchmark:check: cd benchmark && uv run --locked ruff check . ../runtime && uv run --locked ruff format --check . ../runtime && uv run --locked pytest tests ../runtime/tests
scripts.benchmark:format: cd benchmark && uv run --locked ruff check --fix . ../runtime && uv run --locked ruff format . ../runtime
scripts.benchmark:report: cd benchmark && uv run --locked python -m laymbda_benchmark.report
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run benchmark:check
